name: Unstable NHP
effect:
Your Mech gains the AI tag; however, this NHP doesn’t count towards the number of AIs you may have installed at once. You are unable to hand over control of your mech to the Unstable NHP as a Protocol, but it can enter cascade.
Your mech gains “Memetic Spark.”
description: Gained from the Iconoclast: Rank I pilot talent.

name: Armament Redundancy
effect: You may choose to ignore weapon destruction as a result of the SYSTEM TRAUMA result when taking structure damage. This system can only be used once before each FULL REPAIR, and is not a valid target for system destruction.
description: By installing additional armor plating, redundant firing circuits, and enhanced insulation to magazines the longevity of a frame’s armaments can be greatly enhanced.
